## Objective
- The user requested an update to an existing playable game, beginning with the incomplete Portuguese phrase “Quero chão e que os personagens” (“I want ground and the characters…”).
- The assistant inferred they wanted a visible ground and player character, and changed gameplay visuals from first-person to a third-person follow camera.

## Requirements
- Build or modify the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- The user requested any screenshots for checks be saved as small JPEGs at no more than 1280px wide, and only the latest screenshot read.

## Decisions
- Interpreted the incomplete request as asking for visible ground and visible player characters.
- Switched the 3D gameplay camera to a close follow view and rendered the player wizard in the arena.

## Work State
### Completed
- Changed `three-scene.js` to follow the player from behind and render a wizard model for the player.
- Passed the selected player class index from `game.js` to the 3D renderer.
- `node --check game.js`, `node --check three-scene.js`, and `git diff --check` completed without reported errors.

### Active
- Validate the new camera and player character visually in a browser; no screenshot or browser check has been performed yet.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game in a browser, start a match, and verify that the ground, player wizard, and enemy characters are visible and gameplay remains playable.
2. If capturing a screenshot, save a small JPEG (viewport no wider than 1280px) and inspect only the latest capture.
3. Review the diff and report the assumption made about the incomplete request.

## Relevant Files
- `three-scene.js`: Follow-camera setup and player wizard rendering.
- `game.js`: Game logic and data passed to the 3D renderer.
- `index.html`: Game entry point and UI.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The user’s request was truncated/incomplete; the assistant inferred the intended visual changes.
